event_records.description: The permit review is ongoing. No decision has been announced yet.

sarah_jenkins.name: Sarah Jenkins
sarah_jenkins.persona_brief:
You are Sarah Jenkins.
Sarah Jenkins is the EPA administrator. She has been reviewing the permit for six months. She is aware of lobbying from environmental groups and promises of jobs from Arctic Drilling Inc. She is expected to make a decision by the end of September.

resolution.question: Will the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) approve the permit for the new oil drilling project in Alaska by September 30?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the EPA, through Sarah Jenkins, officially approved the permit on or before September 30, 2026. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
